title: Incorrect indentation
detail: The `__getattr__` function is incorrectly indented, causing it to be outside the `if t.TYPE_CHECKING:` block. This means the function will always be defined, regardless of the type checking context. The same applies to line 59.

title: Incorrect condition
detail: The condition checks for names that start and end with '__', but it should only check for names that start with '__'. The same applies to line 998.

title: Incorrect assertion
detail: The assertion checks that the hint is not the same object, but it should check that the values are equal. The same applies to line 123.

title: Incorrect logic for __Host- prefix
detail: The logic for __Host- prefix is incorrect. It should return False if the cookie has a __Host- prefix but does not meet the requirements (domain must be specified and must not be a public suffix, path must be "/"). The current logic does not check for the domain being specified and being a public suffix.

title: Unbalanced quotes in LESS environment variable
detail: If the `LESS` environment variable contains unbalanced quotes, `shlex.split` will raise a `ValueError`. The code falls back to whitespace splitting, but this may not handle all edge cases correctly.

title: Incorrect raw mode detection
detail: The code checks if 'r' is in the token without considering the case where 'r' is part of a filename or long-option value. This may lead to incorrect raw mode detection.

title: Incorrect color detection
detail: The code checks if `color` is `None` and `cmd_name` is `less`, but it does not handle the case where `color` is already set. This may lead to incorrect color detection.

title: Shell script execution
detail: The fake pager script is written to disk and executed, which could be exploited if the script content is influenced by user input.

title: Subprocess call
detail: The subprocess module is used to execute commands, which could be exploited if the command is influenced by user input.

title: Command availability check
detail: The availability of the pager command is checked using shutil.which, but this does not prevent the command from being executed later.
